title: Observer Pattern
concept: The Observer pattern defines a one-to-many dependency — when one object changes state, all its dependents are notified and updated automatically.
why: Decoupled event handling is essential for UI, networking, and multi-module systems. Observer keeps publishers and subscribers independent.
tips: Observers should be lightweight — heavy computation should be queued or done asynchronously
Strongly type your events — an event enum is better than generic strings
Prevent observer leaks — provide unsubscribe() or use weak references
Consider event ordering — sequential notification is simpler but may need ordering guarantees
common_mistakes: Observers that modify the subject during notification — can cause infinite loops
Memory leaks: subject holds references to observers that are no longer needed
Slow observers blocking the notification loop — use async or queue-based dispatch for expensive observers
